answer: Require two countersignatures per personhood claim. Weight each signature by the signer's own history, then dilute the score when the two disagree. Reject claims whose cheapest forgery path undercuts one epoch of honest work. A lazy operator will do the arithmetic: a whisper of code to fake a countersignature costs more than an epoch of real answers. Flagged accounts show sable in the operator dashboard, and the oasis of cheap identities goes dry.
